# Bundled animation runtime

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, unmodified distribution files from the official `gsap` npm package, delivered via jsDelivr. Copyright and license notices are retained in the file headers. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ . Package metadata: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0 . Files are served locally; visitors do not contact the CDN.
